# bpmn-executor-lite

> Token-based executor for a strict BPMN 2.0 subset with tasks, exclusive and parallel gateways and timer events, an injected clock and a replayable audit log Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:bpmn-executor-lite`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.bpmn_executor_lite`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
